title: Saints' Blood Echo
obscured_text: The script is layered with old names. None of them will look at you yet.
A pressure like preserved breath gathers in the stone.
revealed_text: The echo is not a sermon. It is a preserved bruise of memory: Saints who were neither gentle nor wicked, bodies made into landmarks after the blood learned too much.
Their remnants do not forgive. They remember, and remembrance is already a kind of weather.
